selection_rationale.text: The backend-engineer profile was selected because it contains the most relevant evidence for this embedded systems role: Qt development experience (Tecgraf), Android development (DOSVOX), C language proficiency, and a Master's degree in a related field. motivation_letter.subject: Software Engineer Application -- Ground Control Systems

paragraphs.text: I'm writing to apply for the Software Engineer role on the Ground Control Systems team at Harmattan AI. Having worked with Qt for desktop applications and Android for mobile tools, the challenge of building high-performance, Android-based control stations for UAV operations genuinely excites me.

At Tecgraf Institute, I built a prototype annotation platform using Python with Qt for medical imaging, which gave me practical experience with Qt's signal-slot architecture and cross-platform UI work. At DOSVOX Laboratory, I created an Android app for assistive communication using Android Studio, designing touch-based interfaces for users with motor limitations. Together, these projects gave me a solid foundation in both Qt desktop development and Android mobile platforms — exactly the combination needed to adapt and extend QGroundControl.

My Master's studies in Computer Science at Sorbonne Université, focused on images, vision, and computer graphics, have deepened my understanding of graphics programming and systems-level computing. On top of that, my professional experience building data pipelines and automation tools at Back Market shows I can deliver reliable software in fast-paced, high-stakes environments.

What draws me to Harmattan AI is the mission to build autonomous defense systems with real-world impact. I'll be honest — my background is more in data platforms and tooling than in embedded C++ or drone systems. But I have strong fundamentals in C, Java, and systems programming, and I pick up new technologies quickly. I'm genuinely eager to deepen my expertise in Qt/C++ development and ground control systems, and I'd welcome the chance to contribute to your team while growing in this domain.

motivation_letter.closing: I look forward to discussing how my experience and enthusiasm can contribute to the Ground Control Systems team at Harmattan AI.
